_note: 學習路徑內容建置第4批 #2／6：未來 be going to（eng.t_mid.verb.future-going-to，會考級）。be going to + 原形＝早就計畫好的打算、或看眼前證據做的預測；be 要配主詞（am/is/are）；going to 後接原形。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解、play-through 朗讀）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix fg_）。

units.title_zh: 未來 be going to（計畫、眼前證據的預測）
units.can_do: 我能用 be going to + 原形談早就計畫好的打算（I'm going to visit my grandma）和看眼前證據做的預測（It's going to rain），並讓 be 配對主詞（am／is／are）、後面接原形。
units.situation_group: 未來式 The future with be going to
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'be going to' + base verb talks about a plan or intention you decided before now: I'm going to visit my grandma this weekend. We're going to watch a movie tonight.
claims.verification_ref: be going to 表計畫好的打算；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'going to' needs a form of 'be' first that matches the subject: I am going to, he/she/it is going to, you/we/they are going to.
claims.verification_ref: going to 前的 be 配主詞（am/is/are）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: We also use 'be going to' for a prediction based on something we can see right now: Look at those dark clouds — it's going to rain.
claims.verification_ref: be going to 表眼前證據的預測；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: After 'going to' we use the base form of the verb: She is going to study (not 'going to studies' or 'going to studying').
claims.verification_ref: going to 後接原形；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: For plans and intentions you decided before now, use 'be going to' + base verb. The 'be' must match the subject: I am, he / she / it is, you / we / they are.
teach.zh_hint: 早就計畫好、打算要做的事，用 be going to + 原形。前面的 be 要配主詞：I am、he／she／it is、you／we／they are。

teach.body: I am going to visit my grandma this weekend.
teach.zh_hint: 這週末我打算去看奶奶。早就計畫好的打算。

teach.body: We also use 'be going to' when we see evidence now and predict that something is about to happen.
teach.zh_hint: 看到眼前的證據、預測馬上要發生的事，也用 be going to。

teach.body: Look at those dark clouds. It is going to rain.
teach.zh_hint: 看那些烏雲，要下雨了。眼前證據的預測。

teach.body: After 'going to', use the base form of the verb. Do not forget the am / is / are in front, and 'go' must be in the 'going' form.
teach.zh_hint: going to 後面接動詞原形；別忘了前面要有 am／is／are，而且 go 要用 going。

teach.body: She is going to study for the test tonight.
teach.zh_hint: 她今晚打算準備考試。is going to + 原形。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：I already have a ticket. I ____ watch the baseball game tomorrow.（我已經買好票了，明天打算去看棒球賽。計畫好的打算）

distractor_rationales.going to: 前面少了 be；主詞是 I，要用 am going to。
distractor_rationales.am go to: go 要用 going；應是 am going to watch。
distractor_rationales.will going to: will 和 going to 不能疊在一起用；擇一即可。

practice.feedback: 計畫好的打算用 be going to + 原形：I am going to watch the game。

practice.stem: 填入正確的 be 動詞：She ____ going to buy a new bag.（她打算買個新包包。）

distractor_rationales.are: 主詞是 She（單數），要用 is，不是 are。
distractor_rationales.am: am 只跟 I 用；主詞是 She 要用 is。
distractor_rationales.be: 這裡要用隨主詞變化的 is，不是原形 be。

practice.feedback: going to 前的 be 要配主詞：She is going to buy…。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：The sky is very dark. It ____ rain soon.（天色很暗，馬上要下雨了。看眼前證據預測）

distractor_rationales.are going to: 主詞是 It（單數），要用 is going to。
distractor_rationales.is going: 少了 to；應是 is going to rain。
distractor_rationales.goes to: 預測要用 be going to，不是 goes to。

practice.feedback: 看眼前證據做預測用 be going to：It is going to rain。

practice.stem: 填入正確的動詞形式：We are going to ____ a movie tonight.（我們今晚打算看電影。）

distractor_rationales.watches: going to 後面接原形，不加 -s；應是 going to watch。
distractor_rationales.watching: going to 後面接原形，不是 -ing 形式。
distractor_rationales.watched: going to 後面接原形，不是過去式。

practice.feedback: going to 後面接原形：going to watch a movie。

practice.stem: 填入正確的 be 動詞：My friends ____ going to have a party this Friday.（我朋友們這週五打算辦派對。）

distractor_rationales.is: 主詞是 My friends（複數），要用 are，不是 is。
distractor_rationales.am: am 只跟 I 用；複數主詞要用 are。
distractor_rationales.be: 這裡要用隨主詞變化的 are，不是原形 be。

practice.feedback: 複數主詞的 going to 前用 are：My friends are going to…。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: We are going to visit the museum, and then we are going to eat lunch.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：are going to 有沒有寫全（別漏 are 或 to），逗號和句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。going to 口語常自然連讀（像 /ˈɡʌnə/）；兩句句尾自然下收。

lines.text: I'm going to visit my grandma this weekend.
lines.intonation: 平穩、going to 連讀、句尾下收

lines.text: Look at those clouds. It's going to rain.
lines.intonation: 先描述後預測、句尾下收
